requirement.summary: Journey state is a deterministic replay of immutable scans ordered by observedAt, published type precedence and scannerEventId.
Only scans for the frozen plan, matching leg and hub may satisfy contiguous leg dependencies, and terminal state cannot regress.
Loss and found affect one target, while reassignment atomically fences every older-plan movement without deleting evidence.
Consignment creation atomically freezes one valid shared route and one through one hundred stable, unique ParcelPieces.
Consignment state is recomputed from independent pieces and shared reassignment changes every eligible piece or none.
Unknown-response, concurrent and restart replay preserves one scan identity, original response and one projection effect.
Twenty concurrent identical scanner identities converge while semantic conflicts leave no second evidence, Work or Event.
Every fixed arrival permutation yields the same projection as independent total-order replay and retains late early evidence.
Concurrent loss, found and reassignment accepts only a legal serial order and no old revision or other target crosses the fence.
Shared reassignment racing terminal delivery freezes eligible members at one commit point and applies one new revision to all or none.
JOURNEY_PROJECT Work is retained and reclaimed after a claimed-worker death while the stale owner is fenced.
A shuffled duplicate scan storm remains fully replayable after controlled worker deaths and retained Work drains.
CONSIGNMENT_PROJECT uses consignmentId authority and an old lease cannot revive cancelled or superseded route state.
Unknown webhook acknowledgement retries the same committed Event identity and canonical body in contiguous aggregate order.
Runtime and OpenAPI expose closed V1 and Manager member shapes, published errors, pieceRef sorting and tenant isolation.
Production Chromium completes the real V1 route, scan, loss, found and reassignment flow and distinguishes evidence from projection.
Production Chromium presents independent piece journeys, exact aggregate states and shared route operations after refresh.
The FINAL snapshot is one complete sorted point-in-time view whose V1 and piece projections independently replay from evidence.
Every V1 Shipment migrates to one stable legacy Consignment and piece without changing route, scan, projection, Event, Work or replay identity.
The exact 50000 four-leg Shipment creation workload reaches 300 per second at p95 400 ms with atomic connected plans.
The exact 200000-scan shuffled workload with 20 percent replay reaches 600 mutations per second at p95 500 ms and fully deterministic projections.
The exact 10000-shipment loss/reroute load survives two claimed-worker deaths and drains through four replacements within 60 seconds.
